The GPS trace covers the wait with no hole, so the shortfall is settled, not a gap [F5][NS-1]. Because NS-1(iii) fails, the $6.61 is not payable and is refunded in full [F7][NS-2]. No flag or other action has been placed on your account. Keep this wait time in mind on future trips.
